items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was with that band for about a year and a half... He [Kenton] was very kind and tried to give everybody as much publicity and good words and featuring.

ctx.x: How well did you know him?
Not really well but every time we met it was very friendly. We hung out once when we were doing guests on the Stan Kenton tour.
